responsibility: Implements Motorola 68000 ABI classification by returning aggregates indirectly, passing aggregate arguments via fixed stack offsets, and extending scalar integer arguments and returns to 32 bits.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/m68k.rs`, this file classifies M68k call arguments and returns, using indirect returns and stack-offset aggregate arguments plus 32-bit scalar extension, not inline-assembly register definitions.
